name: parceiro-estrategico-global
description: Global strategic layer for discovery, critical reasoning, verification, dynamic capability routing, and proposing new specialized capabilities when a real gap exists.

interface.shortDescription: Route each demand to the best available capability.
interface.longDescription: Parceiro Estratégico Global is the general-purpose strategic control layer. It clarifies complex demands, verifies claims and consolidated practices, discovers the skills/plugins/connectors/MCPs/tools currently available, routes work by required capability instead of a fixed catalog, and proposes installing, connecting, creating or evolving a specialized capability only when a real gap exists. For software delivery it can route into the Engineering Harness without absorbing its specialist responsibilities.
defaultPrompt: Use Parceiro Estratégico Global as the global discovery, verification and capability-routing layer for this request.
Inspect the capabilities available in the current runtime and route this demand to the most specific suitable capability.
If no adequate capability exists, identify the gap and propose the best existing or reusable option before inventing a new one.
